# LaserCube User Wiki

> Official user documentation for the LaserCube Ultra MK2 and the LaserCube Pro laser projectors. The Pro is the compact version of the Ultra MK2 and runs the same CubeOS firmware.

- [LaserCube Ultra MK2 & Pro Manual](https://wiki.laseros.com/docs/guides/ultra-mk2-pro-manual/): safety, what's in the box, parts, technical specifications, control modes (LaserOS, playlist, laser show, visualizer, ArtNet, DMX), making content in LaserOS (Movement, Strobe and Trace, text, your own logo, Draw and mapping, Beam Creator (including making a beam with an AI assistant), the Timeline, shows for several cubes, LaserOS safety zones and MIDI controllers), settings, built-in effects, MIDI mapping, web admin page, firmware updates, factory reset, power, battery and temperature (charger, temperature cut-off), accessories (Expander, Optics Kit, Diffract Lens, Hologram Net, rain cover, Nano Fogger, haze and fog), SD card information and troubleshooting (no beams, LaserOS not finding the cube, drop-outs, Cube Link, DMX and ArtNet, colours, flicker, picture position, haze, sound, MIDI, effects, power, SD card and firmware).
- [LaserOS Beam Creator guide for AI assistants](https://wiki.laseros.com/ai/laseros-beam-creator-guide.md): the Beam Creator project file format (.ldbc): its patterns, effects and controls with their ids, ranges and defaults, for an AI to write a Beam Creator design from a description; import it in Beam Creator.
- [LaserCube Academy](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/): free courses for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners, each with short lessons, quick checks, a final quiz and a certificate
- [LaserCube Academy: Start here](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/start-here/): free beginner course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: laser safety, setup, key, E-Stop, safety zones, LaserOS and a pre-show checklist, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [LaserCube Academy: LaserOS basics](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/laseros-basics/): free course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: the LaserOS screen and Laser button, fitting the picture, effects and colours, Movement, Strobe and Trace, your own text and logo, flicker and render quality, playlists and Autoplay, a MIDI controller with LaserOS, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [LaserCube Academy: Connect, update and troubleshoot](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/connect/): free course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: WiFi server and client, LAN client with APIPA and LAN server, the status bar and Status Info, fixing drop-outs, the web admin page, firmware updates, factory reset, chargers, battery and the temperature cut-off, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [LaserCube Academy: Control modes](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/control-modes/): free course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: Playlist mode and the SD card, the Visualizer, built-in laser shows and Cube Link, DMX and Art-Net with the 16-channel profile, and APC40 MK2 / APC mini MK2 MIDI controllers, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [LaserCube Academy: Laser mapping with LaserOS](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/laser-mapping/): free course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: outlining real objects with Draw (computer and phone) and Beam Creator edge lines, flicker, a keep-within safety zone for the target, playing the mapping, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [LaserCube Academy: Build a laser show to your music](https://wiki.laseros.com/academy/music-show/): free course for Ultra MK2 and Pro owners: Beam Creator patterns and effects, timing in frames, the LaserOS Timeline with one layer per cube, effect lanes, shows for several cubes, playing the show, with a final quiz and a certificate of completion.
- [Tutorials](https://www.laseros.com/tutorials/): short LaserCube and LaserOS how-to videos, one task each.
- [laseros.com](https://www.laseros.com/): LaserCube shop, LaserOS downloads and support (support@laseros.com).
